(one) day (-rite) of which (however) the agnistoma (-laud) is thirty-four-
versed (sixth day) ; (and) a seventeen-versed mahavrata as over-night-
rite of which the out-of-doors-laud is twenty-four- versed, the head nine-
versed, the wings fifteen-versed, the trunk seventeen-versed, the tail
twenty -one-versed (seventh day).

he thrives in all respects.

3. That there is at the beginning an internally attached five-day-
rite, is for continuity '.
1 Cp. XXI. 13. 9.

three deities ; he reaches (becomes equal to) the deities.

7. There are both kinds of stomas, even and odd ones ; this is a

8. In that the head (of the mahavrata) is nine-versed, there being

seventeen-versed ; Prajaipati being seventeen-fold, he reaches Prajapati.
The tail is twenty-one-versed, for getting a firm support.
